maria: Working on docs PR for the secure bootstrap checklist for private installs. Need a quick review on network flow + SDK examples for KMS transport in air-gapped envs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2387

sam: Link looks good. Can you paste the minimal curl + python example here? I'll sanity-check.

maria: Sure. Minimal curl for token auth over proxy:
```bash
curl -X POST https://local-redwood:8443/v1/verify \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  --proxy http://proxy.internal:3128 \
  -d '{"check":"network"}'
```
Python snippet:
```py
import requests
TOKEN = "<redwood-token>"
resp = requests.post(
    'https://local-redwood:8443/v1/verify',
    headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'},
    proxies={'http': 'http://proxy.internal:3128', 'https': 'http://proxy.internal:3128'},
    verify='/etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem'
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

taylor: Two quick notes: 1) call out that curl `--proxy` for HTTPS may require `--proxy-insecure` if certs are self-signed; better to show `--insecure` only for local testing. 2) mention `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` or `verify` path for Python so people don't bypass TLS.

arjun: Also add the KMS/HSM runtime bits: agent needs outbound TCP to kms-host:9000 and the HSM plugin expects /var/lib/redwood/hsm to be mounted (mode=0750). I left a short snippet in the PR under "Platform requirements".

maria: Good catches. Updated PR with CA usage, HSM volume mount note, and a tiny migration checklist for customers moving from Hosted -> Private (export prompts, pin models, re-run eval hooks).

sam: :eyes: Reviewing now. Minor nit: port-matrix link on infra page is broken (404). Replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/networking/port-matrix-v2 — please update.

maria: Thanks — fixed the link and pushed a commit.
